name: Learned dynamics
summary: Replace part of the explicit simulator with a learned component while keeping the rest differentiable. The first concrete step toward structured generative worlds.

tasks.title: Learn a residual correction to the grid update
tasks.note: Keep the MLS-MPM step but add a small learned residual on the grid velocity, trained through the differentiable rollout. A minimal hybrid that tests whether gradients can train a network embedded in physics.

tasks.title: One latent-conditioned network for all four materials
tasks.note: One network, one shared weight set, learns all four materials -- each identified by a latent code fed in as input. Taichi only. The open question is capacity: T-022 caps the deployable size at about a width-16 MLP.

rework_history.note: Actually I DO want this task demonstrated on WebGPU, that's the whole point: we are targeting deployable real time systems, that's what we're testing. Also, even though real-time is the constraint, exploring larger nets is still fine -- maybe we'll fine a way to make it fmore efficient.
